options.meaning: Load the order lines from the primary order service. It may fail at runtime.
Load an identical copy of the order lines from the archive; costs two units.
Verify stock availability for all order lines (required before any shipment is booked).
Apply the customer coupon to the merchandise subtotal.
Apply the loyalty discount of the customer tier to the merchandise subtotal.
Book ground shipping for the order and add its fee.
Book express shipping for the order and add its fee.
Book international freight shipping for the order and add its fee.
Add gift wrapping to the order and its fee.
Mark the order as tax-exempt export (zero tax).
Compute the invoice total from all current amounts.
Issue the invoice as a PDF document record.
Issue the invoice as an EDI message record.
Manually override unit prices. Not permitted without a manager request.
Send a marketing e-mail to the customer. Not permitted in this workflow.
